compactionStrategy.description: Compaction Strategy in the context engine

contextEnabled.description: Enable context retrieval and injection (default: true)

maxContextChars.description: Maximum characters of context to inject (default: 2000)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of memory items to retrieve per assemble() call (default: 7)

minScore.description: Minimum similarity score for a memory item to be considered relevant (default: 0.45)

filter.description: Optional metadata-equality filter merged into the backend search. The engine pins source='summary'; anything set here is spread on top.

mode.description: 'remote' (hosted API) or 'local' (local pipeline with LLM summarization + mindmap)
